backend.description: The remote backend to use, e.g. `remote` or `http`.

config.description:
The configuration of the remote backend. Although this is optional, most backends require some configuration.

The object can use any arguments that would be valid in the equivalent `terraform { backend "<TYPE>" { ... } }` block.

defaults.description: Default values for outputs, in case the state file is empty or lacks a required output.

outputs.description: An object containing every root-level output in the remote state.

workspace.description: The OpenTofu workspace to use, if the backend supports workspaces.

decode_tfvars.description: provider::terraform::decode_tfvars decodes a TFVars file content into an object
decode_tfvars.summary: Decode a TFVars file content into an object

encode_expr.description: provider::terraform::encode_expr takes an arbitrary expression and converts it into a string with valid OpenTofu syntax
encode_expr.summary: Takes an arbitrary expression and converts it into a string with valid OpenTofu syntax

encode_tfvars.description: provider::terraform::encode_tfvars encodes an object into a string with the same format as a TFVars file
encode_tfvars.summary: Encode an object into a string with the same format as a TFVars file

parameters.name: input
parameters.description: Input to encode for TFVars file. Must be an object with key that are valid identifiers
